text:
Ethan V: Quick ask 1: FinEdge wants to upload SOC2 extract + pen-test PDF to our staging bucket. They want a 72h presigned link and to use their own KMS key. Can hosted support this?

Priya M: Hosted cannot accept customer CMKs. We can issue presigned links up to 7 days TTL but server-side encryption will use Redwood-managed KMS. If they require CMK ownership we need Dedicated/Private + commercial review.

Samira J: Security guidance: OK to give 72h presign but recommend shorter (24-48h) and require uploads to prefix evidence/finedge/pen-test/YYYYMMDD/. Enforce header x-amz-server-side-encryption:aws:kms and require metadata tag scan=pen-test so our scanner picks it up automatically.

sec-bot: Attached templates: pen-test-attestation.docx; soc2-excerpt-redacted.pdf. Reminder: automatic malware scan runs within 60m of upload.

Legal: Note on retention: default 30d retention for POCs. Extensions require SOW amendment. For full network diagrams we need NDA + data room; sanitized diagram ok to share.

Ethan V: Billing question from sales: does presigned transfer/storage count against staging free quota?

Priya M: Presigned uploads are billed like any ingress/storage. For POCs we cover the first 50GB inbound+storage by default; confirm per-account. Anything above billed at list rates.

Samira J: Quick bucket policy example (paste):
```
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":"s3:PutObject","Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-evidence/evidence/finedge/*","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption":"aws:kms"}}}]}
```

Ethan V: Action items: 1) Priya confirm account-specific free staging bytes; 2) Samira DM bucket policy snippet and recommended scan window; 3) Legal prep redacted diagram and retention blurb. Ill reply to FinEdge with the 72h presign caveats. Back by 5pm.

Priya M: On it.

Samira J: Will DM policy + suggest scan window 08:00-10:00 PST.

Legal: Preparing blurb now.

Ethan V: Thanks team :thumbsup:
